notes.title: DRAGONSPIRE RETURNS AS A SINGLE PLAYER, OFFLINE GAME
notes.content:
TODAY WE ARE RELAUNCHING DRAGONSPIRE AS AN OFFLINE, SINGLE PLAYER GAME.

[b]NO MORE LATENCY
NO SERVER CRASHES
PLAY ANYWHERE WITH NEW CONTENT AND LOADS OF FUN![/b]

YOU CAN DOWNLOAD THE UPDATE RIGHT NOW FROM STEAM!

IN ADDITION, WE ARE REDUCING THE PRICE TO $4.99 TO REFLECT OUR CURRENT DEVELOPMENT SITUATION (which is we are now a 3-person unpaid team who completed this update out of love for the project). Valve was very supportive throughout this process, but is not equipped to offer partial refunds. If you paid the previous EA price and would like a refund, please open an individual support ticket on Steam to see if you're eligible.

IF YOU WANT DRAGONSPIRE TO CONTINUE BEING MADE, here's how you can help:

[b]1. PLAY EVERY DAY FOR AT LEAST A WEEK.[/b] Read my previous post about retention. Daily engagement will be the single most important metric, and unbroken engagement (e.g. you play every day, even if just a few minutes) is a strong signal of a worthwhile game. Help us be worthwhile!

[b]2. TELL YOUR FRIENDS TO DO THE SAME.[/b] More people, better data!

[b]3. ASK ANYONE WHO WILL LISTEN TO PLAY, INCLUDING YOUR FAVORITE CONTENT CREATORS.[/b] We don't have any budget for advertising, so new player traffic will be completely from word of mouth. The more people you can get to try the game, the better our odds are of success.

We need to show there is genuine interest in the project with metrics if we want someone to fund continued development on Dragonspire. And as awesome as our current volunteer team is, we don't have all the skills necessary to complete the game. Your help promoting Dragonspire to others could save the project!

Speaking of our awesome volunteers, my sincerest gratitude goes out to @Bozo and @Hannah for working on this version with me over the past five weeks; the Dragonspire relaunch would be impossible without their efforts. Contributions were also made by Levin, Duncan, Dylan, Cotton, Tian, Yvonne, Liam, and Sin, which I am also very grateful for. Please join me in celebrating everyone's efforts to rebuild a version of Dragonspire that can live on Steam forever.

As this was a fast effort, we expect some bugs and technical issues may occur. Please report them on Discord so we can troubleshoot and push fixes quickly. If you have questions, I'm around all weekend.

Welcome back to Asteria, and good luck on your runs -

PATCH NOTES:

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Offline, single player is now the default game mode.
[*] Multiplayer and other Keystone-related systems removed.
[*] New pity reward on your first death.
[/list]

[u]Roguelite Drafting[/u]
[list]
[*] New Elemental Crests
[*] - Water: Debuff enemies, earn more Gold, conjure Whirlpools, and dash with purpose!
[*] - Earth: Bolster your defense, become a master Gardener, and push to new heights!
[*] - Light: The elements are always on your side, weave Holy Threads, and banish your foes!
[*] - Revised Dark to be more powerful, including a new vampiric crest.
[*] Banish added as an end game mechanic; remove draft choices from the pool for the rest of your run.
[*] Unique Crests now appear with the proper weight and pre-requisites, you will see them more often.
[*] Added Tundra Charm, Accelerate, and All Fired Up.
[*] Squalls now seek out enemies.
[*] Healing drafts are now all % based. No more pitiful heals!
[*] Updated VFX for Ice Block and Dust.
[*] Shatter now displays Executed when activated.
[/list]

[u]Hunting Log[/u]
[list]
[*] 96 stars can now be earned from Trials. Each star provides a permanent ALL STATS boost to your characters. See if you can collect them all!
[*] Adjusted rewards for beating Sagas.
[*] - You will now unlock new Elemental Crest categories as you progress.
[*] - New heroes will now drop leveled up to the corresponding Saga and difficulty.
[*] - Extra Gold has been added to all rewards.
[*] - Permanent Stat buffs are available at Master as a new reward category (helps with Trials).
[*] - Banish mechanic added as a new reward category (helps with Sagas).
[*] NOTE YOU MUST REDEEM NEW HEROES FROM THE HUNTING LOG, THEY ARE NO LONGER AUTO-GRANTED.
[/list]

[u]Gameplay[/u]
[list]
[*] New Saga: Challenge Aero, a wind dragon who commands the skies using powerful tempests!
[*] New Combo Tracker: Gain 1% damage output every 20 hits, lose it all if you break the combo or take damage.
[*] New Shrine: Gain bonus gold for several minutes. Note you will lose its benefit if you fight a boss.
[*] New Boss Difficulty Scaling: Master is now properly insane, and Desmo may have taken King Slime's crown.
[*] Enemies now respawn after a while (but grant reduced drafting XP on respawn).
[*] Chunky is now vulnerable during Marshmallow transformation. Defeat him quickly or your run is over!
[*] Aero (Dragon) and Marsh-Hell-ow (Boss) added to Trials.
[*] Heroes can be temporarily leveled down to help content creators and those looking for new challenges.
[*] Kirisame Dash Attack now reduces his cooldowns by 1. This mechanic is unique to Kirisame.
[/list]

[u]UI[/u]
[list]
[*] New Victory/Defeat Screen.
[*] New Save Screen: Includes three save slots to support multiple accounts on a single PC.
[*] New Credits: Find out who made the game from your Settings menu!
[*] New Recommended Levels: Helps determine which Saga is right for your average player.
[/list]

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Corrected several boss targeters displaying incorrectly.
[*] Reduced the ultimate targeting range for Breeze and Naomi.
[*] Dragonfruit no longer displays random crests.
[*] Draft choices now stack correctly, including power-ups.
[*] Hyperactive now triggers on the correct duration.
[*] Flamegore's crystals can now be damaged by Echoes (e.g., Inferno).
[*] Found an Easter egg, then lost it again.
[*] Improved hitbox on Blazing Spookybomb's Charge and Swipe attack.
[*] Picked screen for drafts is now accurate and updates in real-time.
[/list]

notes.title: Regarding Major Issues
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thank you so much for your immense support so far! We would like to inform our players about a few important things regarding the current state of the game.

[h3][b]1. Our servers are currently located in North America (East Coast)[/b][/h3]

We are working on expanding our regional coverage for servers. For the time being, we apologize to players located in regions far away from our server and are doing our best to improve your experience.

[h3][b]2. Issues with lobby creation[/b][/h3]

There is an issue where players will hang on the loading screen for "Create a Private Room". When this occurs, please click "Cancel" and try again. This can be repeated numerous times in a row until the lobby starts up. Here's a clip of someone showing this method - https://clips.twitch.tv/FreezingAgreeablePicklesTTours-vtJ1xK4MJ-qylsLI


[h3][b]3. General server instability[/b][/h3]

After going live, we have been encountering severe server instability. This will result in players having their health reset mid-run and their in-game HUD to break partially. We are working extremely hard on stabilizing our servers for the best experience possible!

We're aware of all of these issues and are working tirelessly to push out a fix for them. In the meantime, feel free to join our Discord - https://discord.gg/dragonspire where you can get more direct support from the dev team regarding issues and meet other players to group up with!

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for 6/21/2023
notes.content:
Greetings, Asterians! We hope you've been enjoying the demo so far! We've been watching you all play and hearing a ton of awesome feedback. We've decided to make some adjustments and will be pushing them through in a patch today! Thank you for all your support and we hope you continue to enjoy our demo!

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Player scaling enabled, 65%/100%/125% enemy HP (1/2/3 players)
[*][i]It IS possible to solo the demo now. Let's see who can pull it off![/i] 
[/list]

[b]HEROES[/b]

[u]Breeze[/u]
[list]
[*] Charge Attack full charging duration increased to 1.5 seconds (from 1.3)
[*] R Skill damage scaling reduced to 1.35 (from 1.55)
[*] Q Skill ranged damage scaling increased to 0.8 (from 0.72)
[*] E Skill damage scaling increased to 0.36 (from 0.23)
[*] Design Notes — Breeze is doing well as a caster, but we want to shift some of the damage away from her R Skill and onto her other Skills. We also saw people weren't shooting the Q Skill, which does better damage, so we boosted the reward for players who can hit those shots.
[/list]

[u]Serena[/u]
[list]
[*] Combo Damage Scale increased to 4.13 (from 4)
[*] Charge Attack radius now scales up with each charge (25% per)
[*] Charge Attack fire duration increased to 0.5 seconds (from 0.35)
[*] Charge Attack full charging duration decreased to 2.0 seconds (from 2.6)
[*] Charge Attack damage scaling increased to 0.84 (from 0.72)
[*] R Skill cooldown reduced to 60 hits (from 72)
[*] Design Notes — Serena wasn't meeting our expectations. We have more changes planned for her in Early Access, but for now we are giving her some love to improve her Charge Attack, allow you to spin more often, and shifting some of her normal attack damage forward in her combo. Should feel much better, maybe even a bit OP. #SerenaSupremacy
[/list]

[u]Naomi[/u]
[list]
[*] Dash Attack damage scaling decreased to 0.15 per hit (from 0.2)
[*] R Skill cooldown reduced to 72 hits (from 90)
[*] Design Notes — Naomi is doing very well, but her R Skill cooldown was too long. To account for the effective DPS increase, we removed some damage from her Dash Attack.  - She should feel mostly the same as before the patch, but with a bit more uptime on that R Skill.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]

[u]Gameplay HUD[/u]
[list]
[*] Dash ability icon updated to reflect cooldown.
[*] Character ability icon updated to show a white flash on enemy hit.
[/list]

[u]Hero Screen[/u]
[list]
[*] Hero models can be rotated after their animation finishes.
[/list]

[b]AUDIO[/b]
[list]
[*] Charge attack "charging" audio removed while we continue to work on a resolution for the "jump scare" bug.
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix to Desmo Revolving Misery ability (Big rotating beam of energy) targeter not cleaning up on death.
[/list]
